title: CO2 emissions summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Roser, Rosado), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): ~6 Gt (1950) rising to >20 Gt (1990, ~quadrupled); ~1,600 Gt emitted since 1751; US ~400 Gt (~one-quarter of the total, ~1.5x China's ~270 Gt). Clean version verified internally consistent (20/6 ~= 3.3; 400/1600 = 1/4; 400/270 ~= 1.5) before injecting 3 defects findable from the text's own numbers.
